title: Edit your model
tryWithClaude: Ask Claude: rename every measure that starts with Tot so it starts with Total.

steps.say: Pick a measure in the Model tree. Its properties open beside it.
Query runs DAX and shows the numbers, so you can test a measure before you keep it.
AI instructions tell Copilot and your assistant how to read this model.
Every edit lands in History. Undo takes back any line.
